1.3.2.5 - BRG Results Enabling Facility (BRG-REF) Program
projects.description:
The project will support BRG to effectively carry out its mandate in seven provinces. Technically, and with direct focus on peatlands restoration, the project will target the strengthening of BRG’s skills and competencies relevant to their mandate. External to peatlands, the project will directly assist BRG to strengthen their outreach and networking capacities including the expansion of strategic partnerships with traditional and non-traditional partners and donors. 
A peatlands restoration plan of action will guide BRG UNOPS interventions over the period of the project and also outline exit strategies for the sustainability and upscaling of ongoing strategies during the immediate post project period.

projects.name: 1.3.1.4 - Implementing International Health Regulations for prevention and detection of and response to public health emergencies
1.2.4.1 - Emergency procurement of critical medical equipment to support the Government of Indonesia
projects.description:
The overall objective of the project is to strengthen the health preparedness and COVID-19 response of the healthcare system in Indonesia, and effectively and timely prevent and treat COVID-19 cases. By providing emergency procurement support (medical equipment) to the Government of Indonesia, through the Ministry of Health, the project will enhance the country’s response to the coronavirus outbreak. 

With the overarching aim of procuring urgently needed medical supplies to ensure that hospitals can provide life-saving treatment to infected patients, the following activities will be undertaken:
● Finalize in collaboration with the Ministry of Health, with assistance from the World Health Organization (WHO), and update, as needed, lists/specifications of required medical supplies and equipment.
● Procure required medical supplies and equipment as per UNOPS rules and regulations. 
● Coordinate with the Ministry of Health of the Government of Indonesia to ensure timely delivery of procured equipment to the country.
● Follow up on the MoH on the distribution and receipt of procured equipment to ensure maximum transparency and fairness.
projects.outcome: Output 1.2.4 - UN SERF Pillar I Health First
